这似乎是来自[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的民用飞船专属型号——用于在通讯系统故障时作为紧急措施进行发射——但其受损的严重程度使具体情况都不得而知了。

它一直在重复一个微弱而失真的信号。

texts.zh:
在[From.GetName]和缓的运行轨道上竟漂浮着一枚紧急信标。其外壳已被严重损坏，似乎是被武器火力击中或是被大爆炸波及。

这似乎是来自[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的民用飞船专属型号——用于在通讯系统故障时作为紧急措施进行发射——但其受损的严重程度使具体情况都不得而知了。

它一直在重复一个微弱而失真的信号。
texts.en:
An emergency transmission buoy floats in gentle orbit around [From.GetName]. Its outer casing is heavily damaged, seemingly by glancing weapons fire or a powerful explosion.

It might be a [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] model for civilian ships - designed to be ejected as an emergency measure should the comms systems fail - but the extent of the damage makes it impossible to know for certain.

It is repeating a weak, distorted signal.

label.zh: 也许是陷阱——最好不要以身犯险。
label.en: It could be a trap - best leave it be.

texts.zh: 信标已确定来自[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]，其发射的信号已趋于稳定。
texts.en: The buoy has been verified as one of [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] make, and the signal it's relaying has been stabilized.

label.zh: 这里是[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]帝国。请亮明身份。
彻底关掉。这件事到此为止。
label.en: Shut it down. No one is to speak of this.

texts.zh:
有、有人吗？这里是[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]民用运输船“卢克西昂号”的舰长。

啊，应该说是前舰长。卢克西昂已经不复存在了。我们被海盗登船，我们在飞船爆炸前就被掳走成了人质。
texts.en:
He- hello? This is the captain of the Luxion, a [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] civilian transport.

Uh, former captain. The Luxion is gone. We were boarded by pirates and taken captive before they blew up the ship.

texts.zh:
什么？什么？！你们不能见死不救！

要是他们认为不能用我们向[Root.GetName]索取赎金的话，绝对会连眼都不眨就宰了我们的！就连真的付了赎金的话我们的性命也没有保障啊！你们不能——
texts.en:
What? What? You can't. You can't not save us!

If they get it into their heads that they won't be able to ransom us back to the [Root.GetName] they won't hesitate to kill us. They'll probably kill us even if the ransom is paid! You can't--

texts.zh:
哦，真是太感谢了，太感谢了啊！[Root.GetRulerTitle]。我们似乎被关在某个空间站，但具体位置我也不知道。

我这就加强传输频率，你们应该可以通过紧急信标进行三角测量，确认我们被绑架的位置……
texts.en:
Oh thank you! Thank you, [Root.GetRulerTitle]. We're being held in some space station, but I have no idea where we are beyond that.

I will increase the transmission burst now, it should let you triangulate the location of this prison from the emergency buoy...

label.zh: 位置已记录于情报日志。
label.en: Position recorded in the Situation Log.

texts.zh:
虽说海盗的基地十分隐蔽，但若知道如何寻找的话就十分明显了。

一支舰队排着奇怪的队形慢慢从重新运行的采矿设施后慢悠悠飘了出来——显然是并没想到会有不速之客。
texts.en:
The pirate base, while fairly inconspicuous, is obvious when you know what to look for.

A fleet in confused formation slowly drifts out from behind the re-purposed mining complex - they were obviously not expecting company.

label.zh: 打开通讯系统。必须让被囚者做好准备。
label.en: Open comms. The captives need to be ready.

texts.zh:
你好啊，[Root.GetRulerTitle]。看来这一切都是因为[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的飞船而起的了？

我们好客的主人们似乎即将离开他们当前的位置。登上这地方对各方都不利，但是……如果你直接对基地发起攻击，我觉得我们倒是可以拼一拼，看看能不能弄到一艘救生艇。

我们出来的时候可别把我们给炸飞了！
texts.en:
Hello again, [Root.GetRulerTitle]. I take it [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] ships are the cause of all this commotion?

Our hosts seem about ready to leave their posts. Boarding this place would probably end badly for everyone involved, but... If you attack the base directly, I think we can make a break for one of the lifeboats.

Please try not to blow us up on our way out!

title.zh: 星际绑架者：尘归尘，土归土

texts.zh: 索取赎金的海盗们的基地被摧毁了，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的俘虏们也一道消失了。俘虏们似乎成功联系到了发动进攻的外星飞船，却被对方忽视了。
texts.en: The Ransomeer pirate base has been destroyed, and the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] prisoners along with it. It appears the captives managed to hail the alien ships that attacked, but were ignored.

label.zh: 我们绝不会忘记这个悲剧。
label.en: We will never forget this tragedy.

title.zh: 星际绑架者：意外的救星

texts.zh:
[From.From.GetName]的战斗行动彻底摧毁了星际绑架者的部队。

[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]俘虏在交战中成功逃出，目前已登上一艘救生艇，即将与[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]救援飞船接头。
texts.en:
Military action by the [From.From.GetName] has destroyed the Ransomeer forces.

The [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] captives made a successful escape attempt during the attack, and are now safely on board a lifeboat well on its way to be a rendezvous [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] rescue vessels.

texts.zh:
不知何方发起的战斗行动彻底摧毁了星际绑架者的部队。

[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]俘虏们奇迹般地逃出生天，在攻击行动中偷去了一艘救生艇，即将返回[Root.Capital.GetName]。
texts.en:
Military action by an unknown force destroyed the Ransomeer pirates.

Miraculously, the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] captives managed to break out and steal a lifeboat during the attack, and are now well on their way back to [Root.Capital.GetName].

label.zh: 真是神秘而偶然的遭遇啊。

title.en: The Ransomeers: Picking Up the Pieces

texts.zh:
海盗的基地在我方飞船造成的连锁效应中缓慢地分崩离析。与此同时，我们开始了对卢克西昂号生还者的搜索。

如果他们真的上了救生艇，现在也该联络我们了……
texts.en:
As the pirate base slowly tears itself apart in a savage chain reaction instigated by our military vessels, the search for the captive crew of the Luxion begins.

If they made it to a lifeboat, they should be attempting to hail us by now...

texts.zh:
[Root.GetRulerTitle]，这里是卢西安号的船员。

计划进行得十分顺利。在你们展开对基地的袭击后，卫兵们都跑上船了，于是我们也成功破坏了囚室大门。救生艇无人看守，看来你们给这群海盗造成了不小的麻烦，完全没人注意到我们逃跑了。
texts.en:
[Root.GetRulerTitle], this is the crew of the Luxion.

The plan went off without a hitch. Once you started bombarding the base directly, the guards took to their ships, and we were able to break down the cell door. The lifeboats were unguarded, and it seems you kept the pirates busy enough that they did not care much about our escape.

Hel-


-re no lifeboats, we-


-andoned, collapse im-





------------------------

texts.zh:
被关押的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]最终未能逃出海盗基地。我们并未能确认他们到底是如何死亡的——是救生艇未能成功发射，还是他们压根没有逃出囚室——但这不妨碍我们确认他们已死亡的事实。

[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]们一定会十分感激[Root.GetName]的[Root.GetRulerTitle]采取的迅速行动，但感觉他们短时间内也不会遗忘这出惨剧。
texts.en:
The kidnapped [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] never made it off the pirate base. We are unable to determine exactly where they met their end - if the lifeboat failed to launch, or if they never made it out of their holding cell - but fact remains that they are dead.

The [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] people are sure to appreciate the swift actions undertaken by the [Root.GetRulerTitle] of the [Root.GetName], but they are also unlikely to soon forget this tragedy.

texts.zh:
卢克西昂号的船员安全的回到了[Root.Capital.GetName]，一场灾难就此避免，[Root.GetName]的[Root.GetRulerTitle]的果断行动让[Root.GetAdj]人民十分自豪。

海盗的绑架勒索事件已经成功划上句点，海盗团也被消灭了，但还有一些事没搞清楚，比如被俘虏的人声称他们在被抓后曾经从飞船窗口中看到了更大型的海盗舰队。从目前情况来看，可以确定威胁比我们实际看到的还要大的多。

进行这次勒索行动的家伙们已经被处理了。
texts.en:
With the crew of the Luxion safely on their way back to [Root.Capital.GetName], disaster has been averted. The [Root.GetAdj] people are sure to glory in the decisive actions of the [Root.GetName]'s [Root.GetRulerTitle].

The situation with the kidnapping Ransomeer pirates, as well as the pirate band itself, has come to an end. Some questions remain, mainly relating to the much larger piratical navy the captives claim to have seen through portholes shortly after their capture. But, considering the circumstances, it can safely be assumed that the threat appeared to be much greater than it actually was.

The Ransomeers are over and done with.

texts.zh:
一群自称为“星际绑架者”的海盗关押了[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]私人运输飞船的船员。

我们想在海盗们提出条件之前就救出他们。
texts.en:
A band of pirates calling themselves the "Ransomeers" have kidnapped the crew of a [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] private transport vessel.

We intend to free them before the pirates can make any demands.

texts.zh: 我们发现了一个严重受损的物体，这似乎是一个通讯信标。
texts.en: A heavily-damaged object seems to act as a repeater for a comms signal.
